desc: 蓝天水花草绿瓶，夏日居家清凉氛围详情页
name: 清透草绿夏日花露水款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表与详情首屏用一瓶立于水花的清爽剪影换一眼点击
shots.textZone: 上半留白放一列竖向主标题，瓶身左右三枚空白气泡徽标位

shots.intent: 把夏夜睡不安稳的普遍困扰拍成可见画面，承接首屏停留
shots.textZone: 顶部三分之一留白带放痛点标题，下方两枚空白胶囊位

shots.intent: 用仰视瓶身与环绕气泡把配方与清凉感讲成一张机制图，气泡内容交给占位
shots.textZone: 四枚空白气泡各留一条短语位，底部一行小标题

shots.intent: 把产品放进真实夏夜卧房语境，让买家代入自家床头
shots.textZone: 上方留白带放核心利益标题，底部绿色波浪条放结束标语

shots.intent: 用微距证明瓶身工艺、盖纹与液色，撑起质感信任
把三层核心利益压成一屏可扫读的阶梯，卖点文字全交给占位
shots.textZone: 右侧三枚阶梯胶囊条各放一行短标题

shots.intent: 用一行线性图标把可用场景摊开，让买家自己对号入座
shots.textZone: 四枚图标下方各一枚空白标签胶囊

shots.intent: 用左右两栏并列把两条主打利益摊开对照，帮买家二选一收口
shots.textZone: 左右卡内各一行标题与一条短语位，波浪条放结束标语

shots.intent: 以留白规格表和须知的诚实版式做信任收口，真实数值由商家后期合成
shots.textZone: 三行参数右侧留空白值域，下方须知块留三行空白位

shots.intent: 以三枚空徽标与三步编号版式收尾，把承诺与用法全部交给商家占位
shots.textZone: 下部三枚空白圆形徽标位与三行编号步骤标题位

style.backgroundSystem: soft cloud-like pale sky-mist field #E3F0F7 grading into milky white #FFFFFF, mint leaf-green #DDF0E1 panels and rounded-corner white cards, water-splash arcs and eucalyptus leaf sprigs as the only decoration, never a dark or black field
style.direction: airy cool-botanical household summer lotion commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and blank filled circular medallions in herbal deep green #2F7D4F, one weight only, plus a wavy green divider band
style.lightingSystem: bright diffuse high-key daylight key from the upper left at about 6000K with a fill card on the shadow side, low contrast, one soft contact shadow grounding the bottle, gentle water caustics near the splash arc, no hard speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent airy cool-botanical household summer-lotion commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of milky white #FFFFFF, pale sky-mist blue #E3F0F7 and mint leaf-green #DDF0E1 with one herbal deep green accent #2F7D4F and deep charcoal text #2D2D2D; cool daylight temperature; background system limited to a soft cloud-like sky-mist field grading into milky white, mint panels and rounded-corner white cards, with water-splash arcs and eucalyptus leaf sprigs as the only decoration and never a dark or black field; bright diffuse high-key daylight key from the upper left at about 6000K with a fill card, low contrast, one soft contact shadow grounding the bottle, gentle water caustics, no hard speculars; modern geometric sans-serif with one short Chinese headline in 「」 plus pill bars and one numbered row marker, no dense body copy; thin single-weight line icons and blank filled circular medallions in herbal deep green #2F7D4F plus a wavy green divider band; the bottle stays upright at a stable scale with its ribbed cap, slender squared shoulder, liquid colour and label placement unchanged and its front label kept as a completely blank legible field; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no red or warm promotional hues, no invented numbers, dates or claims.
noDrift: no protection-duration or hours wording rendered anywhere, no time numbers of any kind
no repellent, kill or bite-reduction percentages, no insect species names or illustrations
no cure, treatment or skin-repair claims, no raw or inflamed skin imagery
no ingredient names and no ingredient percentages rendered on bubbles, cards or label
no age indication, no infant or child figure, no unsupervised-child usage scene
no pesticide or health registration numbers, no certification marks, seals, awards or QR codes
no red or warm promotional hues added to the cool botanical palette
no dark or black fields, no metallic gold, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds between screens
no invented readouts, no duplicated bubbles, no floating bottle without a contact shadow
no label artwork redraw: the front label stays a blank legible field
style.presentationRules: the bottle stands upright at a stable scale, ribbed cap on top, slender squared shoulder and liquid colour unchanged, front label kept as a blank legible field with no rendered words, bubbles and leaves ring the bottle but never occlude its silhouette
style.surfaceSystem: a live water meniscus with concentric ripples for the hero, mist-grey glass podium for the benefit screens, white laminate shelf under the spec cards, pale linen bedding in the sleep scene
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one short Chinese headline per screen wrapped in 「」 at 28-44pt, deep charcoal #2D2D2D, plus pill bars and one numbered row marker, no dense body paragraphs
